notes.title: Major Quality Update: Beta 2.0
notes.content:
[b][u]Hello everyone[/u][/b]

Thankyou so much for the support you have shown my project thus far.
Right now I have made changes to all core aspects of the game in anticipation of the release date next year. These changes include but arent limited to:

[b]Revamped Animations
World Interaction
Cutscenes[/b]
[b]Additional Lore and Dialog for ALL NPCS[/b]
[b]Balancing of the magic abilities and reinforcement into class based playthroughs
Cleanup of all maps and assets.[/b]
